create_mistral3_patch_merger: create a Mistral3PatchMerger that merges spatial patch grids using learned linear projection
configure_mistral3_multimodal_projector: configure a Mistral3MultiModalProjector with norm, patch merger, and two linear layers for vision-to-text projection
run_mistral3_get_image_features: run Mistral3Model.get_image_features to extract and project image features from pixel values and image sizes
run_mistral3_forward: run Mistral3Model forward to process text and image inputs and return hidden states with past key values
generate_mistral3_conditional: generate text with Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration by passing image inputs and text prompt tokens
